## Category Details

### ⛔ LEGAL DOCS — Preserve, do not commit
Files in `legal-docs/` are statutory corporate records for CerebroHive Pvt Ltd.
They must **never** enter git history without explicit approval from the legal/company secretary.

```
legal-docs/AoA_CerebroHive_Pvt_Ltd.docx       ← Articles of Association
legal-docs/DIR-2_Consent_Director.docx         ← Director consent form
legal-docs/INC-9_Declaration.docx              ← Incorporation declaration
legal-docs/MoA_CerebroHive_Pvt_Ltd.docx        ← Memorandum of Association
legal-docs/NOC_Registered_Office.docx          ← Registered office NOC
legal-docs/Share_Certificate_SH1.docx          ← Share certificate
```

Action: verify `legal-docs/` is listed in `.gitignore` (or add it). Store these in a
password-protected archive or a separate private repository with restricted access.

### ⛔ EXTERNAL SIBLING REPOS — Out of scope
Per the Codex Changeset Manifest, `git status` from this repo surfaces paths in sibling
directories. Do not stage, modify, or delete anything in these paths from this worktree:

```
../cerebro_hive/       ← separate repository
../../hiveforge/        ← separate repository
../../.turbo/           ← shared turbo cache
```
